newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AUSTRALIA-TELECOMS-Telstra allays AUSTEL concerns on NFR.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AUSTRALIA-TELECOMS-Telstra allays AUSTEL concerns on NFR.

text.p: Australian telecommunications regulator AUSTEL said on Thursday that state-owned Telstra Corp had satisfied AUSTEL's previous concerns that Telstra's National Frame Relay (NFR) tariff regime was anti-competitive.
Telstra sells end-to-end packet switching of digital data on its NFR network, especially useful for companies connecting their computers to on-line networks and transferring large amounts of data.
AUSTEL said Telstra had offered to introduce a new wholesale access product to service providers called Frame Connect.
